newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Koramic, French Lesage strenghten ties.
newsitem.headline: Koramic, French Lesage strenghten ties.

text.p: Belgian Koramic Building Products said on Friday it would closely cooperate with French concrete maker Lesage to ensure further growth of its concrete activities.
"To establish further growth of its concrete activities, Koramic chose for a close cooperation with a group which is specialised in this type of materials," Koramic said.
"The Lesage group on the other hand is aiming to give its activities an international dimension," it said in a statement.
To realise this strategy, Koramic will transfer its concrete vaults activities in Belgium and the Netherlands -- Koraton NV -- to Lesage Prefabrication SA.
Koramic will take a 33 percent stake in Lesage Prefabrication SA, in which Lesage owns 67 percent through its parent holding T.O.L SA.
Koramic, which said it expected 1996 consolidated turnover of about 30 billion francs, added that Lesage Prefabrication was due to make an important investment in Koraton.
